title: E7 loader reads the business-event record (NG-23)
author: dev-blueprint (Amendment B build)

modify.reason: read NG-23 features + workTopic; non-scalar feature value → PrivacyViolation

agent_prompt: E7 reads the ONE business-event store (NG-23): the loader lifts the structural features + workTopic recorded on each request entry into RawDoc, and attach_pseudonyms carries them into FeatureDoc. Structural only — a feature value that is not a scalar (str/int/bool) is a PrivacyViolation (no original text can ride in). No person dimension (NG-21). TDD.
